justification: Rico Dowdle's ruled out and Puka's a doubtful with the training staff saying no, so those aren't character calls, those are just facts on the injury report, and we don't dress a man who can't suit up — Corum steps in at RB2 and Wan'Dale steps in at wide receiver, both of 'em have shown up and done their job when their number's called. Daniel Jones stays our starter under center; he's earned that trust and we're not yanking him because a spreadsheet somewhere likes Trevor Lawrence's number better this week. Amon-Ra and Andrews keep their spots after solid weeks of work, Terry's locked in at flex because he plays hard every single down even when the ball ain't coming his way, and McPherson and the defense stay put — we don't chase matchups, we trust the guys who've earned the reps. Clear eyes, full hearts.
